errors.text_span: Секторът "бензин" е оцветен в тъмно синьо
errors.evidence: The sector for "бензин" (gasoline) is light blue, not dark blue as stated. Dark blue corresponds to the "други" (other) category in the legend, although the slice is more of a medium blue.

errors.text_span: Секторът "електрически" е оцветен в светло жълто и представлява около 13% със стойност 414,098.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "електрически" (electric) to the color light yellow, a percentage of 13%, and a value of 414,098. According to the chart and legend, "електрически" is the gray/black slice with a value of 51,910. The yellow slice is "хибридни" (hybrid), and the value 414,098 belongs to "други" (other).

errors.text_span: Секторът "хибридни" е оцветен в сиво и заема около 2% със стойност 51,910.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "хибридни" (hybrid) to the color gray and the value 51,910. According to the chart and legend, "хибридни" is the yellow slice with a value of 13,466. The gray/black slice with the value 51,910 corresponds to "електрически" (electric).

errors.text_span: Секторът "други" е оцветен в светло синьо и представлява около 0.4% със стойност 13,466.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category "други" (other) to the color light blue and the value 13,466. According to the chart and legend, "други" is the dark blue slice with a value of 414,098. The light blue slice is "бензин" (gasoline), and the value 13,466 belongs to "хибридни" (hybrid).

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени според размера си в низходящ ред.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not strictly ordered by size in a descending (or ascending) order around the circle. The order is дизел, електрически, хибридни, други, бензин, which is not sorted by size.
The value for 'бензин' (1,071,600) represents approximately 35.6% of the total (3,007,920), not 34%. This is a minor inaccuracy.
The value for 'дизел' (1,456,846) represents approximately 48.4% of the total (3,007,920), not 46%. This is a minor inaccuracy.
